annotations.title: Re-check whether one job is still published (free)

description:
WHAT: Re-check ONE job on the employer's ATS right now and report open or closed; optionally return that job's full row with its description.
WHEN: Before applying, alerting or contacting about a specific job you got earlier (job_key or ats + slug + jobId), or to read one job's full details (includeDescription=true).
WHEN NOT: Listing jobs (jobs_get_board) or checking many jobs at once (jobs_search_companies with confirmOpen, paid).
BEHAVIOR: Greenhouse, Lever: one GET to the documented per-job endpoint; HTTP 404 = closed. Ashby has no per-job endpoint, so the whole board is fetched once and searched for the id (method "board_listing"). "open" means currently published by the employer; it does not prove the role is still being filled.
COST: No APIFY_TOKEN, no billing.
RETURNS: One "open_check" row (job = the full "job" row when includeDescription=true and the job is open, else null), or a tool error: INVALID_INPUT, BOARD_NOT_FOUND, HOST_BLOCKED or NETWORK_ERROR (the last two retryable).
PARAMETERS: A malformed jobKey, or neither jobKey nor a complete ats + slug + jobId, returns INVALID_INPUT without a request. An Ashby id costs one full board download (the same request as jobs_get_board); on Greenhouse and Lever a 404 triggers one extra board request so a closed job (status closed) is told apart from a missing board (BOARD_NOT_FOUND). includeDescription adds no request on Greenhouse and Lever (the per-job response already holds the text) and makes the Ashby board download include descriptions; description_text is plain text, <= 20,000 chars, e-mails/phones removed, exactly as in jobs_get_board.
EXAMPLE: {"jobKey":"greenhouse:stripe:8172503"} -> {"status":"open","method":"detail_endpoint"}.

ats.description: Required unless jobKey is given. The applicant-tracking system hosting the board: "greenhouse" | "lever" | "ashby" (the first part of job_key). Example: "greenhouse"

includeDescription.description: Optional boolean, default false. true adds job: the full job row (title, location, compensation, posted_at, description_text, ...) when the job is open. Example: true

jobId.description: Required unless jobKey is given. The ATS job id (job_id field, the last part of job_key), 1-100 chars: numeric on Greenhouse, a UUID on Lever and Ashby. Example: "8172503"

jobKey.description: Optional if ats + slug + jobId are given; wins when both are given. The job_key field of a job row, format "{ats}:{slug}:{job_id}" with ats in lowercase (greenhouse | lever | ashby); any other shape returns INVALID_INPUT. Examples: "greenhouse:stripe:8172503", "lever:palantir:10dfc8bc-99ad-4ca2-ab76-853cb90a92c2"

slug.description: Required unless jobKey is given. Board slug from the public board URL (boards.greenhouse.io/{slug}, jobs.lever.co/{slug}, jobs.ashbyhq.com/{slug}; the middle part of job_key), case-insensitive, 1-100 chars: a letter or digit, then letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-". Example: "stripe"

name: jobs_check_open

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

items.description: Result rows. Each has "type": "job" (job_key, title, company, locations, countries, remote, posted_at, verified_open_at, age_days, long_open, apply_url, source_url, ...), "board", "company", "seed_board", "open_check" or "error" (code, message, retryable)

meta.description: Tool-specific context: board totals, request counts, cost notes

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when done

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

total.description: Total items after filters, before paging
